verdict.rationale: The CLI docs mention an 'auto-approve all actions (use with caution)' toggle, implying a default mode where actions require manual approval before execution, which loosely supports a human-in-the-loop gate. However, there is no evidence of a distinct upfront 'scope/contract approval' step before an agent can touch the repository — no task-plan review, spec sign-off, or pre-execution gating workflow is documented. missing for 10: explicit scope/spec approval step, documentation of a pre-modification review workflow, engineering-lead-specific approval controls.
